transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back, doctor. It's been giving me a lot of trouble.
When did you first start having this trouble with your lower back?
Oh, not that long ago. Just a little while back, really.
Have you ever had a bad reaction to any medicine you've taken?
No, I've never had any trouble with medicines as far as I know.
What medicines, if any, have you been taking recently, including any new or changed ones, and if you know, how much do you take?
Well, I take some tablets for my diabetes, and I've been taking some painkillers from the chemist since my back started. I'm not great with the exact amounts, to be honest.
Apart from your diabetes, do you have any other ongoing health conditions?
No, just the diabetes. That's the only ongoing thing I have.
Have you had any other symptoms along with your back trouble?
No, nothing else really — no numbness or anything like that down below, and I've been fine passing water and all that.
What makes your back trouble better or worse?
It's worse when I bend over, and getting out of the car really catches it. It eases off if I lie on my side, and a hot water bottle helps too.
Is your back trouble there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's sort of always there in the background, though it comes and goes in how bad it is.
What worries you most about your back trouble?
I keep wondering whether I've slipped a disc, and whether I ought to have a scan done. That's what's on my mind really.
In what ways, if any, does your back trouble affect your day-to-day life?
I can't do any of my gardening at the moment, and I even need a hand getting my socks on. It's a nuisance.
Can you describe what your back trouble feels like?
It's a stiff, aching sort of pain, though every now and then I get a sharp twinge with it.
Did your back trouble start suddenly, did it start gradually, or are you not sure?
It came on quite suddenly, actually. I'd been lifting some heavy bags of compost in the garden and it just went.
How bad would you say your back trouble is at the moment — mild, moderate, or severe — or are you not sure?
I'd put it at about a 6 out of 10, I suppose. It's worst first thing in the morning.
Do you take any medicines regularly, have you started or changed any recently, or are you not taking any at the moment — or are you not sure?
Yes, for the diabetes I take gliclazide and metformin — the gliclazide is 80 mg twice a day, and the metformin 1 gram twice a day.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the medicines you're taking?
There's also the ibuprofen I've been taking for the pain — that's 400 mg three times a day, from the chemist.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
